version 5

event TaskClaimed
  at: Time
  task_id: Uuid
  task_name: Text(255)
  queue: Text(52)
  execution: Execution
  attempt: WholeNumber(1..=2147483648)
  priority: WholeNumber(1..=100)
  queue_wait: Duration

event ClaimReleased
  at: Time
  task_id: Uuid
  task_name: Text(255)
  queue: Text(52)
  reason: ReleaseReason

event AttemptPlaced
  at: Time
  task_id: Uuid
  task_name: Text(255)
  queue: Text(52)
  execution: Execution
  attempt: WholeNumber(1..=2147483648)
  child_kind: Execution
  child_pid: WholeNumber(1..=2147483647)
  slot_wait: Duration

event AttemptNotStarted
  at: Time
  task_id: Uuid
  task_name: Text(255)
  queue: Text(52)
  attempt: WholeNumber(1..=2147483648)
  reason: StopReason

event AttemptEnded
  at: Time
  task_id: Uuid
  task_name: Text(255)
  queue: Text(52)
  execution: Execution
  attempt: WholeNumber(1..=2147483648)
  end: AttemptEnd
  run_duration: Duration

event AttemptRecorded
  at: Time
  task_id: Uuid
  task_name: Text(255)
  queue: Text(52)
  attempt: WholeNumber(1..=2147483648)
  record: AttemptRecord
  record_duration: Duration

event TaskRecovered
  at: Time
  task_id: Uuid
  task_name: Text(255)
  queue: Text(52)
  action: RecoveryAction

event ChildStarted
  at: Time
  child_kind: Execution
  slot: WholeNumber(0..=3071)
  child_pid: WholeNumber(1..=2147483647)
  boot_duration: Duration

event ChildReplaced
  at: Time
  child_kind: Execution
  slot: WholeNumber(0..=3071)
  child_pid: WholeNumber(1..=2147483647)
  reason: ReplaceReason

event SlotDown
  at: Time
  child_kind: Execution
  slot: WholeNumber(0..=3071)
  cause: SlotDownCause

event SlotRecovered
  at: Time
  child_kind: Execution
  slot: WholeNumber(0..=3071)

choice Execution: ISOLATED | SHARED_ASYNC | SHARED_THREAD

choice StopReason: CLAIM_LOST | OWNERSHIP_UNCONFIRMED | WORKFLOW_STOPPED | TASK_EXPIRED | NODE_NOT_LINKED | ORPHAN_CANCELLED

choice ShortageErrno: EMFILE | ENFILE | ENOMEM | EAGAIN

choice ReleaseReason: POOL_STOPPING | POOL_FAILED | QUEUE_FULL | NO_CHILD_OF_ITS_KIND | RUNNER_BEATS_FAILED_CLOSED | HELD_FOR_QUEUE_CAP | WORKFLOW_NOT_RUNNABLE | RETURNED_AS_ISOLATED

variants AttemptErrorCode
  BuiltIn(code: Codes(BuiltInTaskCode))
  User(code: Text(128))
  UserOverBound

variants ChildResult
  Completed
  Failed(error_code: AttemptErrorCode)
  WorkerFailure

variants AttemptStart
  Reported(started_at: Time)
  NotReported

choice WorkerDecision: TIMED_OUT | TASK_BLOCKED_LOOP | NEIGHBOUR_BLOCKED_LOOP | CHILD_LOST

variants RunTrace
  Carrier(text: Text(2048))
  NoCarrier

choice WorkflowPlace: NOT_IN_WORKFLOW | WORKFLOW_NOT_KNOWN

variants AttemptEnd
  ReportedByChild(result: ChildResult, start: AttemptStart)
  DecidedByWorker(reason: WorkerDecision, start: AttemptStart, internal error_code: Codes(BuiltInTaskCode), internal trace: RunTrace, internal placed_at: Time, internal child_kind: Execution, internal worker_id: Text(255), internal workflow: WorkflowPlace)
  NotKnown(child_pid: WholeNumber(1..=2147483647))

variants AttemptRecord
  Completed
  Failed
  RetryScheduled(retry_count: WholeNumber(1..=2147483647), next_retry_at: Time)
  ClaimReleased
  NothingOwed
  NotHeld
  LeftToRecovery
  RetriesExhausted
  WriteFailed

choice RecoveryAction: RUNNING_FAILED | RUNNING_RETRIED | CLAIM_REQUEUED | ORPHAN_CANCELLED | PENDING_EXPIRED

choice ReplaceReason: CHILD_DIED | CHANNEL_LOST | PROTOCOL_VIOLATION | PROTOCOL_MISMATCH | KILLED_BY_PARENT | SLOT_DEFECT | SPAWNER_STOPPED | TASK_COUNT | MEMORY_LIMIT | SECOND_CANCEL | LOOP_BLOCKED | LEFTOVER_WORK | AT_DEADLINE | CORE_STOPPED

variants SlotDownCause
  ResourceShortage(errno: ShortageErrno)
  ThreadStartRefused

codes BuiltInTaskCode: OperationalCode | ContractCode | RetrievalCode | OutcomeCode
